title: Grayton Magnolia on 30A's Grayton Beach | Ocean Reef Resorts
meta_description: This newly updated two-story 30A vacation rental home with a gracious columned front is set among towering live oak trees in the historic village center of Grayton Beach. Three spacious bedrooms with multiple beds and bunks can comfortably sleep a dozen lucky beachgoers.
description_expanded: This newly updated two-story 30A vacation rental home with a gracious columned front is set among towering live oak trees in the historic village center of Grayton Beach . Three spacious bedrooms with multiple beds and bunks can comfortably sleep a dozen lucky beachgoers. Grayton Magnolia , formerly known as 12 Magnolia , features a screened-in porch with glass doors that lead into the open living, dining, and kitchen areas. Golden honey-toned hardwood flooring and plenty of sunny windows provide a bright, comfortable setting. A finely patterned rug accents well against a couch and two armchairs with tan safari-style slipcovers. This seating ensemble faces a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV for entertainment above a cream-colored antique cabinet. Crisp white custom-built shelving that displays decorative art is on another wall flanked by two windows and centered upon a majestic mantle. A powder room is conveniently located off the living area. A dining room with a regal Persian rug is near a trio of windows with eight high-backed straw-woven chairs around a charming cottage-style table. The nearby open kitchen has a quartz-topped bar with five raised chairs to enjoy drinks and savory appetizers. Brushed stainless steel appliances are provided to fulfill all of your culinary desires, while a sunny breakfast nook with a round table has four comfortable chairs for charmed dining. A wet bar equipped with an ice maker and wine cooler offers extra room for crafting delightful tropical beverages! The primary bedroom is on the first level with rustic beach-style furnishings that include a king-sized bed and an adjacent sunroom with twin beds. This family-style suite features a luxurious ensuite private bath with double vanity sinks, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-walled walk-in shower. A stately staircase leads to the two guest quarters upstairs. One comfortably appointed bedroom has a king-sized bed, a twin bunk nook, a wall-hung flatscreen TV, and an ensuite tub shower combination. The other coastal-styled bedroom has two queen-sized beds, sunny windows for natural light, a wall-mounted flatscreen TV, and a tile glass-walled walk-in shower. Besides being within easy walking distance to one of the most beautiful beaches in America, this home is steps away from a refreshing private swimming pool. It is on a raised sun deck that connects to the back porch bordered by a paver stone patio beside it with a gas grill and dining areas for fun poolside cookouts. The private pool can also be heated in the cooler months of the year to enhance your vacation experience even further. This lovely beach house is located in the captivating historic village center of Grayton Beach . It borders a precious coastal dune lake with salted artisan spring-fed waters that support flourishing wildlife, a wide variety of fish, and abundant waterfowl. A village dock invites you to try your luck fishing and launch a paddleboard or kayak to explore the lake's natural beauty. The shimmering shoreline beside the lake is part of the nearly 2,000 acres of the Grayton Beach State Park . Forbes Magazine recently named this park one of the most beautiful beaches in America after an extensive national coastline study. The famous Red Bar is walking distance away and provides excellent food, craft cocktails, and live music nightly. The Zoo Gallery across the street features a vibrant array of decorative art, jewelry, and unique beach-inspired furnishings created by select artists. The Tribe Kelley Surf Post next door offers a wide array of chic, fashionable coastal clothing along with handpicked beach-styled accessories. Nearby, the Chiringo's Restaurant & Bar features Spanish Tapas, seafood, favorite drinks, and seasonal entertainment. The popular AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar is also close by, featuring delicious seafood and rollicking dance bands nightly. This 30A locale is also a short distance away from many other great restaurants, beach bars, fashion boutiques, specialty shops, festivals, and outdoor concerts in other picturesque coastal villages. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Master Bedroom with Two Twin Beds and Walk-In Shower + Soaking Tub and Patio Access, Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor: King Bedroom with Twin Bunk and Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Walk-In Shower. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
